title: Relational Coherence and the Languages of Reality
subtitle: Invariant Form, Descriptive Resolution, Directional Structure, and the Physical–Experiential Boundary
purpose: Full mathematical and philosophical monograph on relational persistence, Platonic symmetry, invariant resolution, wave directionality, predication, ontological sufficiency, and the admissibility–occupancy boundary in consciousness science, with a separate expository track for recursive relational models.
